description: Get ready-made video recipes with hook, shot list, interview questions, equipment, recording time, platforms and follow-up formats (one shoot, several posts). Filter by category, words or exact recipe id. Content in German or English (language: de or en); the response also lists all recipe ids. Returns: JSON with dataset, dataset_updated_at, language, total_matches, truncated, recipes, index, categories, coverage. PAID: 0.01 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing. NOTE: Operator-written content, not generated per call. Recipes are suggestions: get consent before filming people and clear locations and rights yourself. The payment buys the lookup; no personal data is processed.

category.description: Recipe category: produkt, mitarbeiter, bts, wissen, kunde, unternehmen or recruiting.

query.description: Plain words matched against title, description and ideas (in the chosen language).

recipe_id.description: Exact recipe id from the index, e.g. tpl-produkt-in-30-sekunden. Returns that one recipe.

name: video_recipes
